_about: Measured rhythm for This Love (愛愛愛, 2006) from the 30 s iTunes previews, via rhythm_candidates.py / rhythm_core.py. tempo_measured is the beat chosen from the onset autocorrelation, not ReccoBeats' tempo.

tracks.name: 愛愛愛
tracks.note: Half-time groove at 66 (133.5 is the octave). Downbeat contrast 4 vs 3 = 0.99 vs 0.36; off-beat at the half.

tracks.name: 蘇麗珍
tracks.note: Contrast 0.94 vs 0.17, lag-4 autocorrelation 0.30 vs -0.53 at lag 3. ReccoBeats 77.5 is not a pulse here; 178.5 is the octave.

tracks.name: 歌手與模特兒
tracks.note: Strong straight eighths (half 0.71 vs thirds 0.15); contrast 0.88 vs 0.21. Could also be counted at 147.

tracks.name: 唉!
tracks.note: Grouping close (contrast 4 vs 3 = 0.63 vs 0.52) but onset autocorrelation peaks at 4 beats (0.49). The strongest off-beat is the last sixteenth (about 0.77): straight, syncopated, not swung.

tracks.name: 四人遊
tracks.note: Clearest as 4/4 at the double tempo 152.5 (contrast 1.30, lag-4 0.54); the beat itself is 75.5. Straight eighths.

tracks.name: 手拖手
tracks.note: Off-beat energy sits nearer the thirds (0.37) than the half (0.24), peak at about 0.65: a triplet / shuffle feel at 68.5. Bar grouping is weak (contrast 0.30 vs 0.23), so 12/8 vs 4/4 shuffle is uncertain.

tracks.name: 偷笑
tracks.note: Accents group in 3: contrast 1.32 vs 0.39, lag-3 autocorrelation 0.33 vs -0.16 at lag 4; at the half tempo 65.5 it also groups in 3. Read as 3/4 at 131 (or 6/8 with the eighth at 131). Subdivision faint.

tracks.name: Goodbye Melody Rose
tracks.note: Triplet subdivision (autocorrelation T/3 = 0.17, T/2 = -0.02; off-beat at about 2/3) with 4 dotted beats per bar (contrast 1.22). ReccoBeats 113.5 is not a pulse.

tracks.name: 詩人的情人
tracks.note: Weak periodicity. At 67: contrast 0.86 vs 0.23, straight. The second candidate 89.5 (4:3 against 67) shows off-beats at about 2/3, so a triplet feel is possible.

tracks.name: 拖男帶女
tracks.note: Clear 4/4: contrast 1.32, lag-4 autocorrelation 0.60 vs -0.19 at lag 3. Straight eighths. ReccoBeats 144.8 is 3:2 against it.

tracks.name: Love Outrolude (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Instrumental. Periodicity at 2 and 4 beats (0.39, 0.40) of 63, i.e. a clear 126 pulse counted half-time. Contrast 0.87 vs 0.44. Off-beat at the last sixteenth.

tracks.name: If You Leave Me Now
tracks.note: Strongest pulse on the album (autocorrelation 0.67). Contrast 1.44 vs 0.41, straight. Chicago cover.

tracks.name: 春風吹之吹吹風Mix
tracks.note: No usable pulse in this preview (onset autocorrelation under 0.1 at every candidate), probably an ambient or free intro. Meter and feel are not measured: 4/4 straight is taken from the original 春風吹 (Soulboy, measured 136 / 68 half-time). Leave the tempo empty or reuse the original's.
